# Is the profit on your open jobs real?

> Free work-in-progress schedule for contractors. Paste your open jobs with contract, estimated cost, cost to date and billings to see percent complete, over- and underbilling, expected losses, cash still to come, a cost-growth stress test and backlog against working capital. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
